svg.title: Mockup 02: the engine composes concurrent moments by region, per zone
svg.text: 02 · Composition: one arbiter, many moments, each in the region it fits, the same on every screen of a zone
Grand final 21:15 on stage · Breakfast 08:00 · Lost and found at the info desk
a · Main hall (Pulse): three moments at once
Tournament standings (rank 60, chain hero → rail) hold the hero, live: points roll as results land.
The crew's announcement (rank 80, chain rail → ticker) takes the rail for 5 minutes, then the rail resumes.
The ticker keeps its lines. Nothing waits, because every moment found a free region of its chain.
Pizza is here · pick up at the café
The check-in code owns the hero by
the zone's choice; the standings are
not for this zone (zones: main, stage).
ticker; the portrait layout has no rail,
so it degrades to a ticker line.
Same moment, its own shape per zone.
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
c · Stage (Dashboard): the crew spotlight grows the hero box to 2 × 2
A spotlight is a ranked moment like any other (chain hero). On a Dashboard the zone's grow_for_showcase
setting grows the hero box; the other boxes shrink to a headline until it ends (design sheet 13).
Follow the exit signs to the car park.
d · Every zone: an emergency takes the full screen
Rank 100, chain full, zones: every zone. Every other moment is hidden, not ended: when the crew
clears the emergency with one action, the standings and the announcement come back where they were,
if their time has not run out. The alarm sound loops on each zone's sound screen.
